name: Nanaka
message: 「And here I was thinking of brewing it myself, gah! Was I one step too late!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaah, I wanna hurry up and get home so I can watch 'It's 7 O'Clock Z'~」

name: Synn
message: 「Then stop talking and finish up already.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. She said Yousuke-kun's 'Roy-Roy!' bit is just the absolute best.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guh... Picking that brutal gag means she really knows her stuff. Hats off to a worthy rival.」

name: Synn
message: 「I have no idea what you're talking about.」

name: Ria
message: 「You're not interested in male idol variety shows, are you, Synn-kun?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, even though they're totally out of reach, you really can't help admiring idols~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even when he pulls something that uncool, he still looks good doing it. Any normal girl would fall head over heels.」

name: Synn
message: 「Which means everyone else around here is abnormal, then.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Ria-senpai, you've gotta have one or two people you admire too, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's the Demon Lord, right? De-mon Lord.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Demon Lord, as in the King of Demons?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep, that's the one. She's basically a pure maiden who can't help admiring a dark hero~\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmph, being called a maiden by you doesn't make me happy at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who knew Ria-senpai admired dark heroes, huh~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a relief! So Ria-senpai really is a normal girl after all~」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Nanaka-chan, what's that supposed to mean!?」

name: Helena
message: 「She's a sheltered young lady at heart, after all. Well, same as me, though.\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the way, Synn. You haven't said a word for a while now.」

name: Helena
message: 「Could it be you're spaced out from hearing that Ria has someone she likes?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. It didn't faze me at all, though?」

name: Synn
message: 「Admiration and romantic love are in completely different leagues!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ah, I get it♪ You were startled by the word 'Demon Lord,' weren't you.」
Could it be that Helena knows I'm the Demon Lord?

name: Helena
message: 「It's fine~ The Demon Lord isn't really that bad of a person, after all.」

name: Helena
message: 「If he were a bad person, don't you think the Human World would be overrun with demons by now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now that you mention it, that's true.」

name: Helena
message: 「So you don't need to be so scared.\s04」
...Does this mean I should just play along...?

name: Synn
message: 「The Demon Lord is seriously terrifying. *Shiver, shiver*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haah, how pathetic for the mighty Student Council President.」
I ended up looking totally uncool, but I guess it's better than having my identity as the Demon Lord exposed....
